rationale: Importer differential lab only: browser-lane and candidate-lane nodes are now paired by the capture's DOM-path anchor, derived from the browser snapshot with a port of the importer's anchor_path, instead of by backendNodeId, which each Chromium session numbers in its own order. An anchor disagreement stays a non-match. The lab doc lists the ten fixtures that cannot be captured standalone. No importer, capture or renderer code changes. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
